description: Account including list of goods and their costs in dirhams, arranged in two columns. Mentions bowls and dishes; sal ammoniac; robes. Verso is headed "beginning of Ramaḍān i.e. Shevaṭ." Mentions: aṣḥāb Dār al-Qarāʾin(?); flax. Expenses are organized according to the day of the week. The account continues with Shawwāl/Adar below. Mentions ṭaḥīn and flour. (Information in part from Baker & Polliack catalogue).
description_he: חשבון הכולל רשימת סחורות ומחיריהן בדירהמים, מסודרת בשתי עמודות.
